models.name: GPT-3
models.notable: The anchor of the modern era — 175B params, few-shot learning, the first model to feel general.

models.name: ChatGPT (GPT-3.5)
models.notable: The public-adoption explosion — 100M users in two months. The moment AI went mainstream.

models.name: GPT-4
models.notable: First model to clear ~85% MMLU; multimodal; the 2023 frontier standard.

models.name: Llama 2
models.notable: Open weights with a permissive license — kicked off the open-model ecosystem.

models.name: Claude 3 Opus
models.notable: Anthropic's first model to match/beat GPT-4; 200K context.

models.name: OpenAI o1
models.notable: The reasoning paradigm — test-time compute / chain-of-thought as a product. Changed the game.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.notable: Open-weights reasoning at frontier level — the 'DeepSeek shock' that proved reasoning could be open and cheap.

models.name: GPT-5.5
models.notable: First model to break the ~57 Artificial Analysis Index ceiling.

models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.notable: #1 on the AA Index the day it shipped — pulled ~Jun 12 by a US export order.
